authority: Decision 2D review (project owner, 2026-10-30): vendors confirmed (The Odds API primary, SportsDataIO secondary); trial verification AUTHORIZED; full purchase PENDING TRIAL; C4 threshold unchanged; no refit; adapters disabled; model RESEARCH_ONLY.

vendor.name: The Odds API
vendor.credit_rule: 10 credits per region per market per event per historical request (vendor-documented; confirmed by the project owner 2026-10-30). Per-call cost is also self-reported in the x-requests-last response header; cumulative usage in x-requests-used (retrieved 2026-10-30).
vendor.snapshot_semantics: closest snapshot at or earlier than the requested date; previous_timestamp/next_timestamp navigation; per-bookmaker last_update

discovery.policy: verified event-ID mapping required before acquisition (owner code inspection 2026-10-30: /sports/{sport_key}/events is a CURRENT-events endpoint and is NOT a reliable discovery source for completed games; vendor docs 2026-10-30: completed games surface via /scores only within daysFrom=3)
discovery.fetch_gate: quote requests require a map entry with non-null event_id and status=='verified'; every other game is ledgered as a discovery miss and SKIPPED (fail-closed)
discovery.go_forward_strategy: for future acquisitions, capture event IDs from /events while games are upcoming (before completion) and archive them to the map

documented_costs.note: Modeled values for PRE-FLIGHT AUTHORIZATION ONLY (projections; /v4/sports documented as not counting against usage, retrieved 2026-10-30). ACTUAL consumption is measured from the x-requests-used/-remaining/-last response headers and reconciled by check V9; modeled never overrides measured.

retry.note: every attempt is authorized against the cap before the request and observed by the Meter after it (owner defect-2 fix, 2026-10-30)

full_acquisition_projections.note: matches the project owner's 2026-10-30 reconciliation: 11,760 (T-180m/T-60m/T-15m) and 15,680 (four snapshots); single region, single market family; discovery/retries extra
